# A Swarm on the Great Bell

*One of Gilbert's swarms has left the roof and settled on the Great Bell in the Royal Plaza. Thin the angry hives at the Chalk Hives that keep calling them out, look at the swarm, and tell Baldwin, who lights the plaza lamps, to keep his flame away from it.*

## Objectives

1. Defeat 40 [Chalk Hive Bee](../monsters/chalk_hive_bee.md) in [The Chalk Hives](../maps/chalk_hives.md)
2. Reach the Great Bell in [Royal Plaza](../maps/selsior.md)
3. Talk to [Baldwin](../npcs/baldwin.md)

## Rewards

- 4,800 EXP
- 560 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +150 standing with [Gilbert](../npcs/gilbert.md)
